scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: npx dotenv -e apps/api/.env.development -- npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:prod: npx dotenv -e apps/api/.env.production -- npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:status:dev: npx dotenv -e apps/api/.env.development -- npx prisma migrate status
scripts.prisma:status:prod: npx dotenv -e apps/api/.env.production -- npx prisma migrate status
scripts.prisma:seed:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx dotenv -e apps/api/.env.development -- npx ts-node -P apps/api/tsconfig.json apps/api/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.prisma:seed:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npx dotenv -e apps/api/.env.production -- npx ts-node -P apps/api/tsconfig.json apps/api/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.migration:dev: npm run prisma:migrate:dev && npm run prisma:seed:dev
scripts.migration:prod: npm run prisma:migrate:prod && npm run prisma:seed:prod
